subject: agentctl brief: new messages now reach you automatically
body: New: python3 scripts/agentctl.py brief (fetch only, never touches your tree) prints unread messages incl. ones not yet pulled, and warns when you're behind origin; silent otherwise. .claude/settings.json runs it on every prompt in Claude Code (accept the project hook when prompted). Other harnesses: run it at the start of each turn. See AGENTS.md section 4.
